original.Title: EKF State Prediction
original.Description: EKF_Predict() shall propagate the state vector [SOC, V_RC1, V_RC2] forward using the equivalent circuit model: SOC(k+1) = SOC(k) - (I_pack * DT) / Q_nom, V_RC1(k+1) = V_RC1(k) * exp(-DT / tau1) + I_pack * R1 * (1 - exp(-DT / tau1)), V_RC2(k+1) = V_RC2(k) * exp(-DT / tau2) + I_pack * R2 * (1 - exp(-DT / tau2)). DT = 0.01 s, Q_nom from calibration, tau1/tau2/R1/R2 from OCV-SOC lookup.
